blockingIssues.description: The guest auth feature only asserts a pre-seeded /auth/signin error banner and never exercises the real /api/auth/callback failure path, so callback/magic-link failure translation remains unproven.

Discovery validation hard-codes the-fox as a live restaurant slug even though the worker evidence shows /restaurants/the-fox did not resolve to a real detail page, leaving the /restaurants/[slug] requirement unproven.
The feature fixed invalid-slug not-found behavior but never established a stable valid public restaurant slug for live detail/booking-entry validation, so its expected behavior remained incomplete.
The runtime-stabilization feature only refreshed Playwright assertions around a still-broken /restaurants/[slug]/book path and did not actually fix the HTTP 500/global error-surface regression.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented PLAYWRIGHT_DEV_HARNESS=1 usage, lack of a stable local public restaurant slug, Playwright .last-run.json dirtiness, and the RSC Lucide icon serialization pitfall in .factory/library/user-testing.md.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Explicitly document where and when to use PLAYWRIGHT_DEV_HARNESS=1 for live-surface Playwright runs that must reuse the existing port-3000 dev server.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both landing-and-discovery-surfaces and related guest discovery validation had to discover the env var ad hoc before specs could run against the live app.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify that live-only runtime regressions may be diagnosed with browser/curl reproduction before RED test updates, and that runtime-stabilization features must not close with test-only changes when the product behavior remains broken.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-valid-public-restaurant-booking-entry-500 needed a live-only diagnosis, while stabilize-valid-public-restaurant-booking-runtime followed RED-first process but still committed only stale-spec changes around a broken flow.

rejectedObservations.observation: Make supported Playwright reporter guidance more prominent everywhere feature verification commands are templated.
rejectedObservations.reason: already-documented in .factory/skills/guest-ui-worker/SKILL.md and too procedural/normative for direct library updates from this validator.

rejectedObservations.observation: Record that f337bc90 was effectively a stale-spec refresh rather than a runtime fix.
rejectedObservations.reason: superseded by the synthesis blocking issue for stabilize-valid-public-restaurant-booking-runtime; duplicating it in library guidance would memorialize a transient feature-specific failure rather than durable repo knowledge.
